content.text:
Made two small improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `scroll-margin-top` to sections so anchor jumps (from nav clicks or the skip link) don't land content flush against the viewport edge.
- Nav active state now updates immediately on click, rather than waiting for the `IntersectionObserver` callback to fire after the scroll settles.

The rest of the page (meta tags, theming, a11y skip link, scroll-spy nav) was already solid, so I kept it as-is rather than adding unnecessary changes.

result:
Made two small improvements to `0.html`:

- Added `scroll-margin-top` to sections so anchor jumps (from nav clicks or the skip link) don't land content flush against the viewport edge.
- Nav active state now updates immediately on click, rather than waiting for the `IntersectionObserver` callback to fire after the scroll settles.

The rest of the page (meta tags, theming, a11y skip link, scroll-spy nav) was already solid, so I kept it as-is rather than adding unnecessary changes.
